title: French Roast Chicken
description: A classic French dish featuring a whole chicken roasted to perfection, served with a side of steamed vegetables. This recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken on all sides until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is roasting, sauté the chopped onion in the skillet until softened.
Serve the roasted chicken with the steamed vegetables and sautéed onion.
Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before carving and serving.
